scenes.title: The Whole Picture: 8 Core Forward Pricing Rules

beats.hindi_tts: The complete chapter at a glance: Eight foundational principles governing forward and futures pricing.
beats.en_subtitle: The entire chapter at a glance: Eight core principles of forward and futures pricing.
beats.en_narration: The complete chapter at a glance: Eight foundational principles governing forward and futures pricing.

ui_state.heading: Forward & Futures Pricing Master Thread
steps: 1. Asset Classification: Investment assets allow two-way arbitrage; consumption assets only define upper bounds.
2. Short Selling Rules: Short sellers must remit all dividends to lenders and provide collateral margin.
3. Spot-Forward Parity: F_0 = S_0 · e^(rT) represents the cost of financing spot storage until maturity.
4. Cash-and-Carry Bounds: Divergence from parity triggers instant riskless borrowing and spot replication.
5. Known Cash Income: Interim cash payments reduce forward prices: F_0 = (S_0 - I) · e^(rT).
6. Continuous Dividend Yield: Continuous dividends offset financing costs: F_0 = S_0 · e^((r - q)T).
7. Kidder Peabody Disaster: Software failure to discount forward STRIPs created $350M in phantom profits.
8. Repo Special Squeezes: High short interest drives repo rates negative and triggers violent forced buy-ins.
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Forward prices represent the no-arbitrage cost of carry, not market forecasts; dividend income reduces carry costs, and proper discounting is vital.
